description: This file defines a PHP class extending an ODBC connection class to support Oracle database operations using ODBC. It includes methods for retrieving table and column metadata, connecting to the database, and configuring session settings.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_oracle
classes.description: A PHP class for Oracle database access via ODBC, extending the ADODB odbc class to include Oracle-specific SQL and connection handling.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_oracle
classes.description: A PHP class representing a record set from an Oracle database accessed through ODBC, extending the generic ODBC record set class.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all table names from the Oracle database.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using provided DSN, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database.
